description: Fetch a full KEGG flat-file entry by ID and return it as parsed fields plus raw text. IDs look like "C00031" (compound), "hsa00010" (pathway), "D00009" (drug), "K00844" (KO/ortholog), or "ec:1.1.1.1" (enzyme). Parsed fields include ENTRY, NAME, FORMULA, CLASS, PATHWAY, DESCRIPTION, cross-references, and more. Use find first to discover IDs. Keyless.
name: get_entry
